C9000226.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 226 (The double-dimer loop ensemble converges to CLE<sub>4</sub>.; papers: The curve scaling limit of half-plane double dimers; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_CAP_VERIFICATION.statement: Universal verification of the signed marked-cap positivity and event-detection mechanism, not the full CLE4 convergence theorem.

C_CAP_DETECTION.statement: The literal eq:pointwise-detection holds on all legal odd corner-rooted rectangle configurations.

C_CAP_GLUE.statement: Formal cap tears preserve uncolored configuration multiplicities and satisfy the marked-cap norm comparison.

C_CAP_COLOR.statement: Direct signed color counting gives uv/2 on one loop and -t_g t_h/4 on distinct loops.

C_CAP_WEIGHT.statement: Nested separating loops have cap totals decreasing by at least one half.

C_CAP_CHAIN.statement: The complete two-chain distinct-loop sum is nonnegative and detects an off-diagonal positive product at level q^2/16.

C_CAP_GENERALIZED.statement: For real M>=1 and B>=1 with B>M-1, unchanged legal configurations with weights B^(-b(A)) have detection coefficient (B-M+1)^2/(2B^(2M)); B=M gives 1/(2M^(2M)).

C_CAP_SHARP_WEIGHT.statement: Actual cap containment and the total cutoff give the sharper decay (M-1)/B, not only M/B.

C_CAP_EVENT_REDUCTION.statement: Finite cell parity, exact color gluing and remote eligible arches give the two chains and the same-loop or head-threshold detection witnesses without assuming positivity.

C_CAP_FORMAL.statement: Kernel-checked arbitrary-finite-chain positivity, head thresholds, integer signs, bilinear color sums and local source/sink trace counts; independent statement-fidelity review remains pending.

C226_MAIN.statement: The full all-macroscopic-curves half-plane convergence theorem, outside this mission's certification scope.

C226_SHORT.statement: Rectangle short-interval exclusion, also requiring the analytic sandwiched insertion estimate.

C226_LOCALIZATION.statement: Uniform localization from rectangles to the half-plane.

C226_IDENTIFICATION.statement: Visible signatures, trace identification and no reverse passage identify the limiting curves.

C226_TOPOLOGICAL.statement: The finite-puncture CLE4 law used by the manuscript; no claim that it implies curve convergence.

C226_SPECTRUM.statement: Odd-width singular modes, delocalization, sector penalty and all-state summability; outside this certification.

C226_CAP_NORMALIZATION.statement: The finite-root cap partition comparison; outside this certification.

C226_CROSSING_RECURSION.statement: Closure of the crossing recursion with the seam maximum; outside this certification.

C226_INSERTION_ANALYTIC.statement: The short-interval sandwiched insertion and marked-contraction bounds; outside this certification.
